# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful describes itself as "Delightful, free party invites. Plan events and parties with friends." ([source](https://partiful.com/)). Its GitHub org lists partiful.com as its website ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is committed in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- A second eas.json is in partiful-app/mobile-legacy ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json in partiful/mobile pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- CI workflows are checked into partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 12 public repos and 180 followers ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).
- The App Store listing has 41,200 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- An open issue in partiful/mobile reads "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)).
- Partiful links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://partiful.com/careers)). The evidence does not say what roles are listed there.

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@partiful-maintainer-1), top contributor to partiful/mobile with 142 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). No title or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@partiful-maintainer-2), 87 commits to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). No title or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@partiful-maintainer-3), 31 commits to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). No title or location in the evidence.

## Why now
partiful/mobile was last pushed on 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)), and the app shipped 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 142 commits in partiful/mobile, which is on react-native 0.74.5 and building through EAS ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)). There's an open issue in that repo about an eas update rollout stuck at 0% on the Android channel ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)). With 6 store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)), is that rollout something you hit once, or does the Android update channel block you often enough that you route fixes through a full build instead?
